question: Why did Target's revenue growth lag Walmart's from FY2022 to FY2024?

hypotheses.statement: Company-specific: Target's revenue growth fell short of its SIC 5331 peers from fiscal_year 2022 to 2024 — refuted if Target's mean YoY growth is within 2 pp of the SIC 5331 peer median

Sector-wide: the SIC 5331 industry (peers excluding Target) grew about as slowly as Target from fiscal_year 2022 to 2024 — refuted if the peer aggregate grew more than 2 pp a year faster than Target on average

Macro: weak real consumer demand (inflation eroding real spending) explains the growth pattern from fiscal_year 2022 to 2024 — refuted if US real private consumption grew at least 1% a year on average
Margin trade-off: Target gave up revenue growth to rebuild operating margin from fiscal_year 2022 to 2024 — refuted if Target's operating margin fell by 0.5 pp or more

evidence.purpose: YoY revenue growth of TGT, WMT and SIC 5331 peers over the window

result.sql: WITH rev AS ( SELECT ticker, fiscal_year, period_end, value_usd AS revenue_usd, LAG(value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_revenue_usd, LAG(fiscal_year) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_fiscal_year FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND (ticker = 'TGT' OR ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM edgar.company_profile WHERE sic_code IN ('5331')) OR ticker IN ('WMT')) ) SELECT CASE WHEN ticker = 'TGT' THEN 'focus' WHEN ticker IN ('WMT') THEN 'named' ELSE 'sic_peer' END AS role, ticker, fiscal_year, period_end, revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_usd - prev_revenue_usd) / prev_revenue_usd, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM rev WHERE prev_fiscal_year = fiscal_year - 1 AND fiscal_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024 ORDER BY role, ticker, fiscal_year LIMIT 200

evidence.purpose: Aggregate YoY revenue growth of SIC 5331 peers excluding TGT (same companies both years) vs TGT

result.sql: WITH rev AS ( SELECT ticker, fiscal_year, period_end, value_usd AS revenue_usd, LAG(value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_revenue_usd, LAG(fiscal_year) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prev_fiscal_year FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE concept = 'revenue' AND (ticker = 'TGT' OR ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM edgar.company_profile WHERE sic_code IN ('5331'))) ), y AS (SELECT * FROM rev WHERE prev_fiscal_year = fiscal_year - 1 AND fiscal_year > 2022 AND fiscal_year <= 2024) SELECT fiscal_year, MAX(CASE WHEN ticker = 'TGT' THEN period_end END) AS focus_period_end, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN ticker = 'TGT' THEN revenue_usd END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ticker = 'TGT' THEN prev_revenue_usd END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN ticker = 'TGT' THEN prev_revenue_usd END), 2) AS focus_yoy_growth_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'TGT' THEN 1 END) AS peer_companies, SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'TGT' THEN revenue_usd END) AS peer_revenue_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'TGT' THEN prev_revenue_usd END) AS peer_prev_revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'TGT' THEN revenue_usd END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'TGT' THEN prev_revenue_usd END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'TGT' THEN prev_revenue_usd END), 2) AS peer_yoy_growth_pct FROM y GROUP BY fiscal_year ORDER BY fiscal_year LIMIT 200

evidence.purpose: US CPI inflation, real private consumption growth and real GDP growth (World Bank) over the window

result.sql: SELECT year, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN indicator_id = 'FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG' THEN value END), 2) AS cpi_inflation_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN indicator_id = 'NE.CON.PRVT.KD.ZG' THEN value END), 2) AS real_consumption_growth_pct, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG' THEN value END), 2) AS real_gdp_growth_pct FROM worldbank.us_macro_indicators WHERE year > 2022 AND year <= 2024 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 200

evidence.purpose: Gross and operating margin of TGT, WMT and SIC 5331 peers over the window

result.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ticker = 'TGT' THEN 'focus' WHEN ticker IN ('WMT') THEN 'named' ELSE 'sic_peer' END AS role, ticker, fiscal_year, MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN period_end END) AS period_end, MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END) AS revenue_usd, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'gross_profit' THEN value_usd END), MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END) - MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN value_usd END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END), 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(100.0 * MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'operating_income' THEN value_usd END) / MAX(CASE WHEN concept = 'revenue' THEN value_usd END), 2) AS operating_margin_pct FROM edgar.company_financials WHERE (ticker = 'TGT' OR ticker IN (SELECT ticker FROM edgar.company_profile WHERE sic_code IN ('5331')) OR ticker IN ('WMT')) AND concept IN ('revenue', 'gross_profit', 'cost_of_revenue', 'operating_income') AND fiscal_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024 GROUP BY ticker, fiscal_year ORDER BY role, ticker, fiscal_year LIMIT 200
